## Review

Independent reviewer, 2026-11-24. Two tests added, both marked "reviewer": `apply-tracker-commands.test.ts` (a turnover between two baskets, sent twice: passes; and a REVIEW FAULT `it.fails`, below) and `rules-change-commands.test.ts` (T-393's write read back from the database: passes, fails with the emptying taken out).

**Medium — the Done browser test never builds.** `tests/browser/kept-statistics-test.mjs:43` only calls `startNext(['start', …])`; it has no `buildNext()` unless `--no-build` block (compare `scoring-plays-test.mjs:97`). The runner gives the first named test no `--no-build` and expects it to build, so `run-web-browser-tests.mjs kept-statistics-test` serves whatever `apps/web/.next` holds: a stale build is possible, as builder four saw. In the whole chain it is safe (the exit test builds first). Fix: add the usual block.

**Medium — a turnover cannot be taken back once turnovers are turned off.** `statistic-of-tap.ts:11-12` names `unturnover` and `team-unturnover` as turnovers, so after the admin switches "Statistics kept" to the standard set mid-game, the scorekeeper's undo of a turnover taken earlier is refused and set aside; the turnover stays in the game's events for good, hidden while turnovers are off and back on the public pages if the admin turns them on again. Proven by the `it.fails` test "takes back a turnover recorded while turnovers were kept" (`expected ['refused'] to equal ['accepted']`). Right: a take-back is always taken (the engine already refuses one with nothing to take back). Fix: drop the two take-backs from `statisticOf` (the transfer check follows), turn `it.fails` into `it`, correct T-391's text.

**Medium — the copy upload does not say which play was not taken, or why.** `game-copy-upload-endpoint.ts:252-265` counts a not-kept play in `notTaken`; the page says (`tracker.ts:818`) "the game's rules refused it, or another device took the game". The uploader is not told it was a turnover nor that "Statistics kept" is the cause, and the server does not hold the play. Fix: count those apart in `GameCopyUploadReply` (from the reply's `notKept`) and word it naming the statistic and the setting.

**Low — a named list survives a save that keeps the same choice.** `set-season-rules.ts:78` empties `stat_keys` only when the statistics part changes; a season holding a named list shows the rules' set on its settings page while its public pages show the list, and saving that same choice changes nothing. Nothing is lost today: in the database only the migration default `'{}'` writes it (no seed, transfer or import does; only the stand-in world names a list). Fix, when an import writes a list: show it as its own choice in "Statistics kept".

**Low — the transfer's look-ahead reads taken steps too.** `run-tracker-transfer.ts:289` checks every segment, so a half-sent game whose turnovers were taken while kept cannot be finished after the switch. Safe (it refuses), only strict. Checked: the refusal comes before `createPerson`/`addToRoster` and planning only reads, so nothing is moved or added on any path.

**Not faults (checked).** A refused not-kept play is not recorded, so a retry judges it again and the baskets answer `duplicate` (new test). An older tracker gets `rule`, which its queue already set aside: no endless resend, the plays after are taken, the queue does not stop. A live switch: the device keeps its button until it reads the rosters again and its taps are then set aside and listed; the server judges by the season as it stands; the public box score of every game, played ones included, follows the season's current choice (`read-game-page.ts:374`, S-1, step 2.196): turnovers are hidden, not deleted, which is right and reversible.

**Broken by hand.** Server taking every statistic plus the screen always drawing the turnover button: 8 unit tests failed in 6 files, and `kept-statistics-test` (fresh build) 6 problems. T-393's emptying taken out: the new database test failed. All restored.

**Ran, on a build made at 22:33 from this tree.** `kept-statistics-test` 11 checks, `game-copy-test` 31, `scoring-plays-test` 709 (294 s). Vitest: core `games` + `imports`, tracker feature, commands and copy-upload endpoints 1386 tests (with the breaks: 8 failed, as intended), `apply-tracker-commands` 41/41, `rules-change-commands` 3/3.
